author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Adam's collection of esoteric medical tools comes in handy in surprising ways around the workshop, but these tools need a home and don't fit into a normal tool rack. So for today's quick build, Adam quickly fashions a foamcore storage box for these oddly-shaped tools and explains why this is one of his favorite ways to build bespoke shop storage. 

Shot by Adam Savage and edited by Norman Chan
Music by Jinglepunks
